title: Agentic Nesting：一种用于现有企业应用集成与服务的新方法论
summary: 本文提出Agentic Nesting，一种多智能体协作框架，将现有企业应用封装为分层嵌套结构中的自主AI代理，通过中央编排器实现任务分解与动态调度，并提供统一对话界面，实现跨应用查询与流程编排，克服传统集成方法（如ESB、API网关、RPA）的局限性。
summary_en: This paper proposes Agentic Nesting, a multi-agent collaboration framework that encapsulates existing enterprise applications as autonomous AI agents in a hierarchically nested structure, coordinated by a central orchestrator, with a unified conversational interface, overcoming limitations of traditional integration methods.
